en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Salih Bin Saeed, 
(It has been narrated) from one of the two (5<sup>th</sup> or 6<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>), said, ‘

I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man who stole, so his hand was cut by the establishment of the proof against him, but he did not return what he had stolen. So how should one deal with the property of the man whom it had been stolen from, or is there not the returning upon him? And if he were to claim that there is nothing in his possession anymore, neither less nor more, and that is known to be from him?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He would be made to work until he pays back the last Dirham he had stolen’.
